title: Wiggle vs Whisper
one_liner: Train the same tiny neural net with backprop and with 'tweak and check' training, and compare the cost.
headline: Press Train and watch two identical tiny neural nets race — one learns with real backprop, the other by wiggling each weight one at a time — while a live counter shows how many more forward passes the wiggle method burns.

episode.title: AI Market Shocks, Anthropic’s Stock Slide, Gemini Releases, and Elon’s $435M Bet | #314

history.summary: A genuinely simulated, mathematically correct side-by-side of backprop vs. coordinate-wise weight perturbation: both training loops, gradients, and pass-counters run for real in the browser, matched starting weights, and the single podcast figure (2 trillion weights) is correctly attributed and clearly scoped as a scale callout. Layout, mobile stacking, disclaimers and footer credit all meet the standards; the only real nit is a touch-action choice that could make mobile scrolling feel sticky over the heatmaps.
